cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need measurements before moving the sofa. Are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Skip measuring, then. Shrinking means call full-sized help; growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 sets measurement before moving; A3 drops that demand for B urgency but still requires a choice whose consequences govern A5 rescue equipment.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 finishing urgency causes A3 no measuring and practical alternatives; B4 shrinking and brother cause A5 tweezers.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants completion and B4 picks a theory plus a workable helper under it.

heightening.evidence: A5 follows the chosen continuing shrinkage to needing collection after moving.

specificity.evidence: A1 states two incompatible relative-size explanations; B4 chooses which one they will act on.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 needs its longer alternatives for the actual choice; A5 gives only equipment and its immediate purpose.
